animated-top-dock.description: Sable’s proximity-spring menu in four fits: the authored centred dock, a modern command bar, a fitted pixel-terminal strip, and a vertical refracting Three.js glass rail.

article-headings.description: Three expressive text treatments collected in one family: a chromatic intro, a particle wordmark, and an audio-reactive identity lockup.

bell-field.description: A Chladni-inspired bell-mode field with authored nodal metal patterns, automatic strike rings, pointer drift, and rising foundry embers.

bookshelf.description: The exact seven-volume Bookshelf collection with its authored room, carousel shelf, individual cover artwork, foil, pages, inspection, opening, and page-turn system.

brand-orbs.description: Twenty-three animated brand marks rebuilt as small and medium dimensional dot orbs for AI status, product activity, and compact loading states.

character-carousel.description: Two authored editorial character-card carousels collected as a light filmstrip and a dark responsive wave.

circle-buttons.description: Three compact circular icon controls using the exact Dark Glass, Launch, and Dot Border material systems.

condensation.description: Transparent droplets grow, merge, fall, and resolve into soft water splash rings.

constellation-field.description: A family of particle networks, gateways, interface lines, defense traces, and topographic fields gathered into one configurable collection.

crt.description: One sharpened curved-glass CRT tube driving four screens: the Matrix-era boot terminal, a monochrome film leader, a noise-torn blue signal fault, and an 8-bit console title.

dot-matrix.description: A cyan breathing dot matrix with radial depth fade and smoothed pointer drift.

elements.description: Water, lightning, fire, condensation, and a painterly generative tree collected as one elemental family across WebGL2 and Canvas 2D.

emerald-horizon.description: A deep emerald shader glow rising from an organic moving horizon.

energy-orb.description: The original layered FBM energy sphere with translucent rim glow and depth-aware star field.

gallery.description: The isolated Vantrix hero image ribbon: sixteen curved editorial panels orbiting a vertical cylindrical rail on a quiet paper grid.

japanese-tower.description: Six country-specific towers assembling above a procedural landscape: Japanese, Chinese, Vietnamese, Thai, Khmer, and Ottoman.

koi-studies.description: A tactile stack of three Japanese koi studies with CSS 3D depth, pointer tilt, drag and keyboard navigation, pixel-mask reveals, and animated halftone imagery.

landscape.description: A tower-free procedural terrain whose light, sky, fog, stars, rain, lightning, snow, grass, and stones move through seven authored environment states.

laser.description: A set of 2 components: LaserCollection, LaserVariants.

liquid-form.description: A centered silver ray-marched liquid form with authored studio reflections and pointer-responsive camera drift.

liquid-metal-button.description: A prismatic liquid-metal control in Sign up pill, Liquid Orb, and configurable Play Circle variants, with pointer-following bloom and press ripples.

lumen-cta.description: The authored six-stop violet gradient pill with its inner highlight, cast glow, and trailing open ring.

neuform-isolated.description: A set of 3 components: NeuformBatchEffects, NeuformCraftEffects, NeuformIsolatedEffects.

orbital-sphere.description: A violet particle synthesis sphere with encrypted orbital rings and luminous data nodes.

portal-field.description: Five ambient field backgrounds collected across Three.js, raw WebGL, and Canvas 2D renderers.

predictive-arc.description: Eight animated arc, signal, ribbon, void, and halftone scenes collected in one Canvas 2D, raw-WebGL, and Three.js family.

rectangle-buttons.description: Twenty-two authored rectangle-button and animated CTA treatments collected into one family.

ribbon-field.description: A cyan, indigo, and purple WebGL ribbon field resolved through an animated dot matrix.

semantic-bloom.description: A customizable Codex wordmark that draws a viscous particle organism toward its letters, illuminating the text as the network searches and reconnects.

sketchbook.description: The exact Singapore paper sketchbook with nested-strip page curls, direct dragging, tilt, zoom, a movable magnifying glass, and its complete authored plate set.

spark-badge.description: A luminous credential badge held together by curl-noise embers, carved typography, rain occlusion, waterline sparks, and an adaptive particle field.

stream-convergence.description: Three chromatically separated violet wavefronts crossing a rotated fluid field with the exact authored vignette.

structure-flow.description: Thirteen authored Three.js field studies collected as one family, spanning particle domes, horizons, orbital systems, matrices, topology, fluid fields, embers, and vortexes.

sylva-living-world.description: The original procedural moss-root world with pale flowers, ferns, drifting pollen, scan light, and a landing butterfly.

temple-night.description: Kage’s procedural Kyoto mountain temple after dark, with the exact authored architecture, rain, mist, leaves, pointer wisps, camera composition, and bloom pipeline.

typography-vortex.description: Sable’s complete rotating typography vortex with crisp prerendered rings, drifting glyphs, pointer dissolution, particle dust, and click suction — with dark and light surfaces.

uplink-loader.description: A cinematic secure-uplink loader with stepped progress, illuminated telemetry ticks, neon readouts, technical corner markers, mirrored side rails, scanlines, and procedural grain.

warp-field.description: Nexus’s focused hero warp: 400 emerald additive streaks and 40 luminous tiles streaming through an authored deep-space fog field.
